rows.title: Roles and addresses page: intro, warning, Consignor name, named add links and full addresses
rows.detail: Brings the roles and addresses page's words and rows in line with Design Release 2.1 inside the summary list DR1 kept (c-087). The page gains an intro paragraph, the fraud warning loses its full stop, the consignor party is called 'Consignor' rather than 'Consignor or exporter', every empty row offers a link that names what it adds instead of a bare 'Add', and an answered row shows the whole chosen address, not just the name, so a trader can check every address without opening each picker. Every new or changed string carries a Welsh machine draft.
acceptanceCriteria: Under the heading 'Consignment addresses' the page shows the paragraph 'Add all the addresses that are involved in the consignment.' (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-004; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p6-004; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p3-004)

The warning reads 'Providing a false address is an act of fraud' with no closing full stop, and its Welsh text has no closing full stop either (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-005; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p3-005; document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p6-036)

The consignor row is labelled 'Consignor', and the consignor picker's heading and page title say 'Consignor', in English and Welsh; 'Consignor or exporter' no longer appears on either page, and the consignor picker's address is unchanged (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-020, prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-137; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p3-008, prototype-dr2-1-specs-p3-027; document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p6-030)

Empty rows offer the links 'Add a place of origin', 'Add a consignor', 'Add a consignee', 'Add an importer' and 'Add a place of destination', each opening that party's picker (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-019, prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-021, prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-023, prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-025, prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-027; document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p6-034)
An empty CPH number row offers the link 'Add a CPH number', opening the CPH number page (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-028; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p3-017)
An empty row still reads 'Not added yet', and an answered row still offers 'Change' (document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p6-037; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p9-008)

An answered party row shows the name on its own line, then each address line on its own line, the last ending with a comma and the country name, such as 'Hull, HU9 5PX, United Kingdom' (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-032; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p6-033; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p3-046; document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p6-027)

With the page in Welsh, every string this change adds or alters shows a Welsh counterpart, still marked as an unreviewed machine draft (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p9-029, repo-frontend-p9-089, repo-frontend-p9-090; document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p6-031)
The page has no serious or critical accessibility violations (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p9-002)

rows.notes: Combines four thin slices that all change the roles and addresses page's copy and rows (intro and warning; Consignor rename; named add links; full address on answered rows), because each repeats the same page, copy files and tests for little gain apart. The summary list stays (c-087); the prototype's headed sections are set aside. c-103: the id, route and address-book role of the consignor stay as they are, and the overview task hint 'Consignor or Exporter, ...' stays. c-089: the visually hidden suffix on the add link goes, as the link now names the party. req-619 (Welsh for every new or changed string) sits here and every other row of this area keeps the same rule. The tests repo's page object and specs that name 'Consignor or exporter' and the 'Add' link change with it (repo-tests-p5-006, repo-tests-p1-084).

rows.title: Same-as shortcuts on the roles and addresses page
rows.detail: Lets a trader fill the consignor from the place of origin, and the importer and place of destination from the consignee, with one button press on the roles and addresses page, as Design Release 2.1 draws. The button copies the source party's record onto the notification as an independent copy, so a later change to the source does not ripple through.
acceptanceCriteria: With a place of origin chosen and no consignor, the Consignor row shows a 'Same as place of origin' button styled as a link beside 'Add a consignor' (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-033; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p6-042; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p3-049)

With a consignee chosen and no importer, the Importer row shows a 'Same as consignee' button styled as a link beside 'Add an importer'; with a consignee chosen and no place of destination, the Place of destination row shows a 'Same as consignee' button beside 'Add a place of destination' (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-034; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p6-043, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p6-044; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p3-050)

No same-as button shows while its source party is empty or its target party already has an address, and no other pair of parties offers one (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p6-049, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p6-050; prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-038)

Pressing a same-as button reloads the roles and addresses page with no success banner, the target row showing the source party's name and full address with a 'Change' link and no same-as button (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-035, prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-036; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p6-045 to trace-prototype-dr2-1-p6-048; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p3-051)

After copying, changing the source party to a different address leaves the copied target party's address as it was (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-037; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p3-052; document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p6-021)

The copy is made even when the source address does not carry the target party's role, and the target party then shows that address (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-037; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p6-099)

The copied party carries the source's name, address lines, country and contact details through to check your answers (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-036; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p9-085, repo-frontend-p9-086)

The same-as buttons work with JavaScript turned off, and every new string has a Welsh machine-draft counterpart (document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p6-023; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p9-089)
rows.notes: Combines the three same-as buttons and their shared show and copy rules: one page form, one copy behaviour, one set of tests. c-100: DR1's collision block does not hold this back. Today the summary list sits outside the page's form (document-dr1-parity-backlog-p6-023), so the buttons need the form around them. Order: build after the roles and addresses page copy row (it asserts the full address and the named add links) and after the role-filtered pickers row (the 'copy even when the target's picker would not offer it' criterion needs role-carrying records). On the compose stack the role-carrying record for that criterion is set-up for a one-page assertion, allowed by the test rules.

rows.title: Which sections the roles and addresses page shows, when its task is complete, and where it continues
rows.detail: Makes the roles and addresses page ask for exactly what the consignment needs and say honestly when it is done. The CPH number is left out for two more germinal product codes; a 'Permanent address' section appears for 01061900 consignments with a species that needs one; the task counts as complete only when every shown section is; and 'Save and continue' goes on to the contact address for this consignment page, or to the overview once everything is complete.
acceptanceCriteria: A consignment whose commodity codes are only 05111000, 05119985, 0101 or 01061900 shows no CPH number row; any other consignment shows it (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-011 to prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-015; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p3-018, prototype-dr2-1-specs-p3-025, prototype-dr2-1-specs-p3-026, prototype-dr2-1-specs-p4-036)

For commodity code 01061900 with at least one selected species that needs a permanent address, the page shows a 'Permanent address' section with the hint 'A permanent address is where an animal:', the bullets 'will permanently reside' and 'can be checked by the Animal and Plant Health Agency (APHA)', and the link 'Add a permanent address' (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-013, prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-016, prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-030; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p3-019, prototype-dr2-1-specs-p3-022 to prototype-dr2-1-specs-p3-024)
No other consignment shows the 'Permanent address' section (prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p3-019; trace:animals-fit trace-animals-fit-p14-026)

The overview's 'Roles and addresses' task shows Complete only once every party has an address and, where shown, the CPH number or permanent address is given; with any shown section empty it is not Complete (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-039, prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-040; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p6-080)

'Save and continue' on the roles and addresses page opens the contact address for this consignment page (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-043; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p6-039; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p3-048, prototype-dr2-1-specs-p4-040)

When every overview section is already complete, 'Save and continue' opens the overview instead (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-044; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-124)
Reached from check your answers to change an answer, 'Save and continue' still returns to check your answers (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p9-026)
Every new string has a Welsh machine-draft counterpart (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p9-089)

prototype-dr2-1-specs-p3-018 to p3-026, p3-048, p4-036, p4-040

rows.notes: Combines the page's section rules (CPH exemptions, permanent address section), task completion and the continue destination: they share the parties obligations, the commodity rules and the journey flow, and are reviewed together as one behaviour. c-091 (two more CPH-exempt codes), c-104 (completion counts every shown section), c-092 (continue goes to the contact address page; the change-context return stands). Where 'Add a permanent address' leads, and the permanent address and contact address pages themselves, belong to the cph-permanent-and-contact area: build this after that area's permanent address page row, so the link and the completion criterion can be observed. The tests repo's page flow expects the CPH number page after this page today (repo-tests-p1-086) and changes with it. This row changes shared code (the parties obligations, the commodities CPH-exempt list, the journey flow) that other areas also touch.

rows.title: Party picker layout: add button, search control, results heading and count, address lines and blank save
rows.detail: Brings the five party pickers' layout in line with Design Release 2.1: 'Add a new address' becomes a secondary button beside the heading, the search label is medium and the search runs from an icon button, a 'Select an address' heading and a reworded results count sit above the table, the table sits in one fieldset, each address line takes its own line, and saving with nothing chosen goes back to the roles and addresses page without an error.
acceptanceCriteria: On each of the five pickers on the compose stack, 'Add a new address' is a secondary button beside the picker's heading, and no 'Add a new address' link sits under the intro; in stub mode the pickers offer no add control (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-053; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p6-054; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p3-029; repo:tests repo-tests-p5-022, repo-tests-p5-024)
The picker's search label 'Search' is styled as a medium heading (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p6-071)

The search runs from a search icon button beside the box whose accessible name is 'Search'; there is no secondary 'Search' text button, and with JavaScript turned off pressing the icon button narrows the list on the server (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p6-071; document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p7-053, document-dr1-parity-backlog-p7-054)

Under the search, each picker shows the heading 'Select an address' above the results count (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-059; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p6-056; document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p7-017)

The results count reads 'Showing <visible> out of <total> results' in English, with its Welsh counterpart, and changes when a search narrows the list (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-059; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p3-036; document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p7-018, document-dr1-parity-backlog-p7-019)

The address table sits inside one fieldset whose legend 'Select an address' is read by a screen reader but not shown (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p6-057; document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p7-020)
The Address column shows each address line on its own line, with no commas joining them (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-060; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p6-066)

Pressing 'Save and continue' with no address chosen shows no error and returns to the roles and addresses page, the party still empty, or still holding the address it held before (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-072, prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-073; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p6-078, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p6-103; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p3-055)
Choosing an address that is not, or no longer, in the organisation's book is still refused with its party error (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p9-181)
Every new or changed string has a Welsh machine-draft counterpart, and the picker has no serious or critical accessibility violations (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p9-089)
rows.notes: Combines the picker's presentation slices (add button, search label and icon button, heading, count, fieldset, address lines) with the blank-save change: all change the shared picker template, its copy and the same tests, so building them apart would repeat the set-up five times over. c-093: where 'Add a new address' leads stays as today's INS handshake (c-106, party-address-add-and-edit area); only its look and place change here. c-105/c-094: the icon button submits the form so search still works without JavaScript. c-095: the count moves out of the table caption. c-098: a blank save is no longer an error, but the refusal of a record not in the book stays (req-604). The tests repo's fit and e2e tests that expect the 'Select a <party> from the list' error and the comma-joined address change with it.

rows.title: Role-filtered party pickers on one page with a live filter
rows.detail: Gives every address-book record one or more roles and makes each party picker offer only the organisation's addresses for its role, all on one page, filtered as the trader types. The address book stores the roles and lists one role's addresses unpaginated; the animals frontend asks for the picker's role. Records saved before roles existed are offered on every picker until given a role, so nobody loses an address on a guess. Stub mode gets roles on its canned records so it filters too. Because each page is now one role's addresses, pagination and the 'Selected address' inset go.
acceptanceCriteria: On the compose stack, an address saved with only the consignee role appears on the consignee picker and not on the place of origin, consignor, importer or place of destination pickers (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-063; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p6-070, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p6-098; document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p6-047)
An address saved with the exporter role appears on the consignor picker; there is no separate exporter picker (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-064, prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-137)
An address saved with several roles appears on the picker of every party whose role it carries (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-065)
An address-book record with no role appears on all five pickers, on the compose stack and in CDP (document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p6-051)

The address book returns an organisation's addresses for one requested role in a single unpaginated list, carrying each record's roles, and never returns a deleted record (document:dr1-parity-notes document-dr1-parity-notes-p1-022, document-dr1-parity-notes-p1-023; document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p6-050, document-dr1-parity-backlog-p6-052)

In stub mode, each picker lists only the canned records that carry its role, so the five pickers do not all list the same addresses (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p9-168, repo-frontend-p9-169, repo-frontend-p9-170)

Each picker lists every address it offers on one page, with no pagination links, however many addresses the role has (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-063; document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p7-052, document-dr1-parity-backlog-p7-056, document-dr1-parity-backlog-p7-057)

With JavaScript, typing in the search box hides, without a page reload, every row whose name, address lines and country do not contain the typed text in any case, and the results count updates to match (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-057; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p6-074 to trace-prototype-dr2-1-p6-076; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p3-054)

The picker shows no 'Selected address:' inset; a party's chosen address shows as its checked row when the picker is reopened (document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p7-050, document-dr1-parity-backlog-p7-055)

sources.ref: document-dr1-parity-backlog-p6-047 to p6-056, p7-049 to p7-057

rows.gate: Look at role filtering on the compose stack and in stub mode before the rows that rest on it build: a role-carrying record appears only on its roles' pickers, a record with no role appears on all five, the list is one page, and the live filter and the no-JavaScript search both narrow it. The same-as row and the place of origin country search build on this.
rows.notes: Combines role filtering (address book roles and role-scoped list, the animals frontend asking by role, untyped fallback, stub roles) with one-page listing, the live filter and dropping the 'Selected address' inset, because c-094 rules they land together: one page is only sensible once it is one role's addresses, and the inset only existed to carry a selection across pages. c-100: DR1's typed-record block is lifted; the typed record is built here in trade-imports-address-book. c-101: untyped records show on every picker until given a role, in the compose stack and CDP alike, never filtered on a guess. The animals frontend's address-book service stays read-only (c-106). Giving a record its roles through the INS address book's add and edit pages belongs to the address-book-add-and-edit and party-address-add-and-edit areas; on the compose stack the role-carrying records these criteria use are set-up for a one-page assertion through the address book, which the test rules allow, so this row does not wait for those pages. The tests repo's pagination and later-page-selection tests (repo-tests-p5-013, p5-018, p5-020) change with it.

rows.title: Place of origin picker searches by country
rows.detail: Gives the place of origin picker the country search Design Release 2.1 draws: its own label, hint and placeholder, and a country autocomplete that keeps the rows in the chosen country. Without JavaScript, submitting a country narrows the list on the server.
acceptanceCriteria: The place of origin picker's search is labelled 'Enter a country' (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-054; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p6-072; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p3-035)

Its hint reads 'Enter each country that the consignment will travel through' (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-054; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-127, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p13-103)
Its search box shows the placeholder 'Search for a country' (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-054; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p6-072)

With JavaScript, typing offers country suggestions and keeps only the rows whose country contains the typed text; picking a suggestion keeps only the rows in exactly that country; clearing the box shows every row again (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-055; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p6-073, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p6-101, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p6-096)
Without JavaScript, submitting a country narrows the list to addresses in that country (document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p7-054)
The other four pickers keep their 'Search' label and free-text search, and every new string has a Welsh machine-draft counterpart (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p9-053, repo-frontend-p9-089)
rows.notes: Combines the place of origin picker's label, hint, placeholder and country filter: one picker, one search control. c-102: adopted as the prototype draws it, though the hint reads like transit-country copy; no DR1 judgement or constraint overrides it. Order: build after the role-filtered pickers row, whose live filter and one-page list this country filter builds on, and after the picker layout row, which reshapes the search control.

rows.title: Picker 'View' link to the INS address book and back
rows.detail: Replaces each picker row's in-place 'View details' expander with a 'View' link that opens the address in the INS address book, and makes the INS address book bring the trader back to the same picker. The INS frontend stays the one place an address is shown in full.
acceptanceCriteria: Each picker row ends with a 'View' link, and there is no 'View details' expander (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-062; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p6-060)

On the compose stack, following 'View' opens that address in the INS address book, and its back control returns the trader to the same party picker of the same notification (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p6-061; prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-062)
The 'View' link has a Welsh machine-draft counterpart (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p9-089)
rows.notes: Kept apart: it is the area's only change to the INS frontend and carries a cross-service return path the others do not. c-097: the prototype wins; the INS frontend must honour the return path, and the tests repo's in-place expander test (repo-tests-p5-014) changes with it. In stub mode, where no INS frontend runs, the fit suite observes the link's presence only; where it leads is observed on the compose stack. The builder should accept only a return path inside the animals journey, as the INS add handshake already does (journey-registry), so the link is no open redirect; this is a safeguard, not a source requirement, so it is left out of the acceptance criteria.
